title: Sea View Land Above Amed Bay
highlights: Full sea view over Amed Bay
description: Twenty ares of terraced hillside above Amed Bay with an uninterrupted sea view and Mount Agung rising behind. Amed is East Bali's diving and freediving hub, with a fast-growing boutique resort scene and a fraction of the south's land costs. Sold to a client for a 6-villa eco-resort development.
investmentNote: Closed at $6,500 per are — a level that no longer exists on the Amed hillside. Ask us about comparable early-stage coastal positions in East Bali.
